bff4a335.text: 两周没有产出，Raymond 会问。我替你顶着。

b5053aef.text: Two weeks without a deliverable and Raymond will ask. I'll hold him off.

8d6cf1ed.text: 昨天谢谢你替我坐下。汉口路那家 Manner，我每天一点在。今天也在。

49c1d5ef.text: Thank you for sitting down for me yesterday. I'm at the Manner on Hankou Road at one every day. Today as well.

e1ebee7b.text: 没事。就是冲出来一张片子，想第一个给你看。

33990f45.text: It's nothing. I've just developed a picture and wanted you to be the first to see it.

d5eb47f8.text: 发了。小猫贴纸的点赞比我的脸还多，我有点受伤😂

fc820686.text: Posted. The cat sticker got more likes than my face. I'm a little hurt 😂

ad338463.text: You came. On time, for once.

2692dc92.text: 你还是这样，看东西先看毛病。

f7af85cf.text: You haven't changed. You always see the faults first.

8a2b3044.text: 嗯。你妈让你按时吃饭。挂了。

dd7ae107.text: Mm. Your mother says eat properly. Bye.

fac39300.text: ……你自己的事，你自己想清楚。钱够不够？

7ed9ffc9.text: ...Your life, you think it through. Do you have enough money?

5a583990.text: 白白，妈妈看到你朋友圈了，那个车……你爸还不知道。你自己注意安全，按时吃饭。

d73578d4.text: Baibai, Mum saw your Moments. That car... your father doesn't know yet. Be careful, and eat properly.

ddb83121.text: 十一月就这样，白天看着还暖和，一过五点天就暗下来了。

a2ed31cd.text: That's November. Looks warm in the daytime, then after five it's dark.

6ddd8cfa.text: 对岸东方明珠刚才亮灯那一下，江面上全倒映出来了。

964db413.text: The Pearl Tower lights came on just now. The whole river lit up with it.

7f6ec5dc.text: 昨晚和平饭店门口那事，吧台的小妹说是你？可以啊纪白。

0c1d2d7a.text: That business outside the Peace Hotel last night. The girl on the bar says it was you? Not bad, Ji Bai.

a1e48278.text: 我们的机械臂末端正好缺一双眼睛。

43f5bc4c.text: The end of our arm happens to be missing a pair of eyes.

a9d93aad.text: 怎么样？在外滩开这台车，整条路的人都在看您。

7489ddb8.text: Well? Drive this along the Bund and the whole street watches you.

b3e6c31f.text: 白白！来来来。这是周学长，我们学校机械系的，现在做协作机械臂。

ce547453.text: Baibai! Come in. This is Zhou, a senior from our university, mechanical engineering. Cobots now.

f2a2f943.text: 白白，帮个忙。我想给赛车做个数据记录仪：CAN总线读转速和刹车压力，GPS记圈速，再加个陀螺仪看G值。你会做吧？零件我出，送到你那个创客空间。

a6569b51.text: Baibai, a favour. I want a data logger for my race car: revs and brake pressure off the CAN bus, GPS for lap times, a gyro for the g-forces. You can build that, right? I'll pay for the parts and send them to your makerspace.
